# Synthetic database fixtures

No real Termius profile or user credentials are included.

- `chromium/`: generated by headless Google Chrome using its native IndexedDB API. Databases are named `hosts`, `ssh_configs`, `ssh_identities`, and `groups`; each has an object store of the same name with `keyPath: 'id'`. The only surviving host is `中文主机` / `192.0.2.1:2222`, linked to `root` / `synthetic-password` and `Synthetic group`. A second host (`id: 9`) was inserted then deleted in the same transaction. The random loopback origin is local to the fixture generator, never contacted by tests.
- `leveldb/`: generated independently by `github.com/syndtr/goleveldb/leveldb` v1.0.0. Put `current=live-value`, put then delete `deleted=old-value`, call `CompactRange(util.Range{})`, then close. Exercises real SST blocks/footer, manifest and compaction, independently of the importer.

Both fixtures contain only the CURRENT file, selected MANIFEST and data files; browser profile logs, credentials and LOCK files are excluded. Other encryption and identity tests use synthetic values created in the test process.
